what: the module tree record kept each inline module's outline position in its file; a `pub use` added to `a` moved `r`'s position in the same file, and the one-group solve of `r` lowered the item at the old position (`b`'s). The walk rows of a childless module are empty both ways, so the record's check passed. Three byte-equality tests failed with no enums or macros in them.
cost: one differential test (the same one-group solve walking and from the record, with each tree) named it in one run, after CM spent its context reading resolve.rs
cause: a position in a record that is read against a newer text (rule 71: keys and records hold item-relative positions)
class: a record field that is a position in a text the reader holds newer than the writer
prevention: done: a reader finds an inline module by its name under its parent in the outline as it is now (task/lower.rs inline_child); left: drop `item` from the record (VERSION 3)
